gloss: concise and clear; plain and simple

definitions.gloss: concise and clear; plain and simple
definitions.explanation: Describing writing, speech, or explanations that are both brief and easy to understand. Combines the ideas of simplicity and clarity.

examples.japanese: {簡明|かんめい}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧。
{簡明|かんめい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がける→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: I try to write in a clear and concise style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{簡明|かんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦{資料|しりょう}→資料：04166_shiryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{配|くば}られた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: Materials that summarized the complex system clearly and concisely were distributed.

notes:
{簡明|かんめい} is a na-adjective combining the ideas of brevity and clarity. It describes writing, speech, or explanations that are both brief and easy to understand.

FORMS:
{簡|かん} (simple, brief) + {明|めい} (clear, bright).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {簡明|かんめい}な⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧: clear and concise explanation
- {簡明|かんめい}な⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: clear and concise writing
- {簡明|かんめい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to summarize concisely
- {簡明|かんめい}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: clear and concise expression

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧: concise, succinct (emphasis on brevity)
- ⟦{明瞭|めいりょう}→明瞭：20647_meiryou⟧: clear, distinct (emphasis on clarity)
- {簡潔明瞭|かんけつめいりょう}: clear and concise (four-character compound, more emphatic)

WATCH OUT:
Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{感銘|かんめい}→感銘：10561_kanmei⟧ (deep impression).

REGISTER:
Formal/written. Common in academic and professional contexts.
